senses.gloss: m. (<cite ref="A02841"><he>אפש</he></cite>, √<cite ref="A02595"><he>אף</he></cite>, cmp. <he>הפץ</he>; corresp. to b. h. <cite ref="N01084"><he>נֶפֶשׁ</he></cite>, v.
units: Jer. XV, 1) desire, pleasure; [only with personal pron. as suffix].
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 4:5">Naz. IV, 5</cite> <he>אי אַפְשִׁי וכ׳</he> I will not live with an offensive woman.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 12:3">Keth. XII, 3</cite> <he>אי א׳ לזוז וכ׳</he> I cannot leave my husband’s house. Y. Yoma VII, 45ᵇ bot. <he>אי א׳ שיכפר וכ׳</he> I do not want the Day of Atonement to bring me forgiveness.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 13:1:5">Y. Yeb. XIII, beg. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ בנישואיך</he> I am willing to marry thee.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:15">Num. R. s. 13</cite> (alluding to <cite ref="Genesis 3:22">Gen. III, 22</cite>) <he>אמר אדם אי א׳</he> said Adam, I cannot (do penitence). Said the Lord, ‘And now’,—said Adam ‘pen’, ‘by no means’, ‘I will not’.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:6:3">Y. Keth. VII, 31ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אי א׳ אשה</he> (read <he>באשה</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 8:1:9">Y. Pes. VIII, 35ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>א׳ שתמנה</he> (read <he>אי א׳</he>). Y. Gitt. VI, 1; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> <he>אי אַפְשֵׁנוּ וכ׳</he> we desire neither him nor his divine protection.
